数过多、训练和推理成本过高；对音频，还要兼顾全频带、高采样率和时序连续性。作者试图给出一套偏工程化但系统的设计答案，而不是只在单一模态上做局部优化。","importance":"对预训练和统一多模态建模的意义在于：tokenizer 不是前处理，而是生成系统的一部分。它决定 latent 空间的几何结构、信息瓶颈位置、后续模型的 token budget，以及训练动态是否稳定。很多关于 AR+diffusion 联合建模、原生多模态 LM、音视频生成的讨论，最后都会落到“离散或连续表示该怎么压缩、压到什么程度、是否利于生成器学习”这些问题上。KVAE 的价值不在于提出一个全新理论，而在于把 image/video/audio tokenizer 放在同一设计框架下，明确强调 diffusability 与 compression ratio 的共同优化，并给出一系列架构和训练上的取舍。对做视觉 tokenizer、语音 tokenizer、统一 latent space 或多模态 pretrain 的人，这类工作很有参考意义。","technical_approach":"方法上，KVAE 是一组面向 latent generative model 的 encoder-decoder tokenizer。视频部分给出两个主要配置：4×8×8 压缩、16 通道的 KVAE-3D，以及 4×16×16 压缩、64 通道的 KVAE-3D。图像部分是 8 倍空间压缩、32 通道的 KVAE-2D。音频部分是 48 kHz 全频带连续 tokenizer，latent 频率 50 Hz、64 通道。论文的重点不是某一个损失函数，而是围绕“高压缩但仍适合 diffusion 学习”的整体设计。\n\n视频 tokenizer 的几个关键设计值得注意。第一，作者采用 attention-free 主干，以 Conv3D 为核心计算块，而不是在 tokenizer 内大量使用时空注意力。这样做的原因很直接：训练更省、推理时可以通过 cache 处理任意长序列，也更适合长视频和 image-to-video 等因果场景。第二，模型采用 causal setup，使用非对称时间 padding，使 tokenizer 同时适配图像和视频输入，并避免未来帧泄漏。第三，时空下采样和上采样按顺序执行，而不是一次性混合处理；这和一些视觉 tokenizer 的 patchify 方案不同，作者明确提到 KVAE-4x16x16 把 patching 留给 downsample block，而不是在最前层就做强压缩。第四，使用 spatial RMSNorm，以支持推理时 segment size 调整。第五，encoder-decoder 采用不对称参数分配，尤其在高压缩版本里显著加宽 decoder。这个设计反映出作者的判断：在高压缩 regime 下，编码器负责提取稳定 latent，解码器需要更强容量去恢复细节，因此参数不必平均分配。\n\n从全文表述看，作者还把 diffusability 当成 tokenizer 的一等公民指标，而不是只看 PSNR/LPIPS 或感知音频指标。也就是说，一个 tokenizer 即便重建不错，如果 latent 分布不利于 diffusion 学习，整体生成系统仍会吃亏。论文后半部分专门讨论 visual domain 中 diffusability 的评估，以及若干设计消融，这一点比单纯报 reconstruction 指标更接近生成系统的真实需求。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验覆盖 reconstruction、generation、diffusability 评估和设计消融四部分。视觉部分，KVAE-3D 与现有开源视频 tokenizer 在重建和生成两类任务上比较，指标包括 PSNR、LPIPS，以及生成侧的 Fréchet Distance 一类指标；KVAE-2D 则在图像 tokenizer 上做对应评测。音频部分使用 PESQ 等客观指标，并强调 48 kHz 全频带、50 Hz latent、64 通道这一配置。摘要声称 KVAE 在 reconstruction 和 generation image-to-video 相关设置，而不是只在短片段上比较。第三，论文单独讨论 diffusability 评估和设计消融，意味着作者试图回答“为什么这个 tokenizer 更适合生成”，而不只是“它重建得更清楚”。如果后续阅读全文，最值得核对的是：高压缩版本 4×16×16(64ch) 相比 4×8×8(16ch) 在生成质量、训练稳定性和 token 成本上的具体 The central question is how to build latent representations for image, video, and audio generation that jointly satisfy three competing requirements: strong compression, good reconstruction, and a latent space that is easy for downstream diffusion models to learn. In practice, these goals conflict. Aggressive compression reduces token count and makes generation cheaper, but it can damage fidelity and make the latent distribution harder to model. The KVAE family is presented as a unified answer to that design problem across modalities.","importance":"This matters for pretraining and multimodal foundation models because the tokenizer defines the effective sequence length, the information bottleneck, and part of the geometry of the learning problem seen by the generator. In latent diffusion, and even in AR-plus-diffusion hybrids, tokenizer design directly affects training speed, sample quality, and scaling behavior. The paper is useful less for a single isolated metric win and more for treating image, video, and audio tokenization under one design lens, with explicit emphasis on the trade-off between compression ratio and diffusability. Current models condition every denoising step of the current frame on fully denoised past frames. These clean frames expose too much local detail, so the model can copy nearby texture instead of modeling temporal semantics and motion. Adding the same noise level to the context removes too much guidance and hurts temporal consistency.","importance":"The work is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is useful for AR-diffusion hybrid modeling. The main lesson is that autoregressive context should not always be maximally clean. The amount of visible information in the context must match the generation stage; otherwise the model either learns shortcuts or suffers from train-inference mismatch. Similar issues can appear in unified multimodal LMs, autoregressive video-token generation, and masked or diffusion language modeling.","technical_approach":"In-Context Forcing treats diffusion noise as a form of masking and uses a progressive context schedule. Nearby frames are given more noise, while distant frames are given less noise. The rationale is practical: adjacent frames contain the strongest copyable local details and therefore need heavier masking, whereas distant frames mostly provide scene and semantic constraints. For training, the paper introduces a Step-wise Rolling KV Cache. It stores KV states for each denoising noise level and performs a bottom-up rolling update after a frame is completed, maintaining progressive noisy contexts while matching inference behavior. For inference, the method uses cross-frame causal attention, reducing the need for multi-level KV caches to a single cache and enabling parallel denoising across frames.","experiments":"The experiments cover both standard short-video generation and extended long-video generation, with comparisons to CausVid, Self Forcing, and Rolling Forcing-style approaches. The reported claims are improved temporal consistency, stronger inter-frame dynamics, and faster single-GPU inference without a clear quality loss. The supplied content does not include exact metric values, model sizes, data sizes, or speedup numbers, so quantitative conclusions should be checked in the tables. The most relevant ablations are clean context versus same-noise context versus progressive noisy context, plus the effects of Step-wise Rolling KV Cache and cross-frame causal attention on consistency, memory, and speed.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 20–30 minutes. In the experiments, focus on context-noise ablations, attention visualizations, long-video stability, and memory/speed comparisons. This is relevant to process supervision, reasoning data generation, and the interface between pretraining, mid-training, and reasoning-oriented fine-tuning.","technical_approach":"Woodpecker Distillation treats the weak model as a diagnostic probe rather than a teacher that provides full solutions. Given a problem x and an intermediate prefix c produced by a strong model A, a weak probe model B samples several short reasoning patches. Each patch is inserted after the same prefix, and A continues generation. Patches are labeled as positive or negative according to whether the final continuation reaches the correct answer. The method keeps a trainable strong model A_theta and a frozen reference model A_ref. It uses A_ref to estimate the future token distributions induced by positive and negative interventions, then builds a contrastive teacher distribution that emphasizes continuations associated with successful repair. A_theta is trained to match this teacher. This differs from patch imitation, which only copies weak-model text, and from full-trajectory imitation, which can dilute the local correction signal over many downstream tokens.","experiments":"The paper instantiates the strong model as Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and the weak probe as Gemma-3-4B-IT. Table 1 reports Pass@16 improvements from the A-B-A intervention, with larger gains on harder sets such as AIME 2025 and Omni-Hard. closed-form 的 layer edit 视角：遗忘不一定要靠 SGD 近似求解，也可以在局部线性化假设下直接解最优更新。第二，它把 retain/forget trade-off 写成了带 ridge 正则的约束最小二乘问题，这对理解“为什么某些遗忘方法会伤 head，也可以是 MLP block 的 down-projection。作者先对 forget 数据和 retain 数据各做一次前向传播，收集进入该矩阵的输入向量，按列堆叠成 key 矩阵；这些 key 只在“下一个 token 应该被遗忘或保留”的位置提取，因此编辑目标是 token-level 的，而不是整段样本级别的。\n\n随后，作者构造一个 ridge-regularized least-squares 目标。直观上有两部分：一部分要求编辑后的矩阵在 forget keys 上把输出推向预设的“遗忘目标”；另一部分要求在 retain keys 上尽量保持原输出不变。由于目标对 ΔW 是二次凸的，最优加性更新 ΔW* 可以闭式求出。这样做和 LoRA/GA/RKLD/NPO 这类方法的差别很明确：它们通过梯度下降在参数空间里逐步逼近一个折中点，GROM likelihood on a forget set while preserving utility on a retain set, but this is expensive, tuning-heavy, and often only hides the unwanted knowledge. The authors argue that such forgetting can be fragile: low-bit quantization may recover content that appeared erased. Their goal is not to design yet another unlearning loss, but to reformulate unlearning as an analytically solvable matrix update problem. The model applies a one-shot additive edit to selected layers, suppresses targeted outputs or representations, preserves retained behavior, and does so without backpropagation or iterative optimization.","importance":"Its main value for foundation-model research is conceptual rather than purely operational. GROM shows that unlearning, local editing, and constrained post-hoc model updates can be cast in a closed-form optimization framework instead of being treated as another fine-tuning recipe. That matters for three reasons. First, it gives a more interpretable view of the retain-forget trade-off through ridge-regularized least squares. Second, it offers a concrete explanation for why some gradient-based unlearning methods may fail under quantization: the unwanted behavior may survive in a recoverable low-magnitude subspace. Third, it suggests that at least part of model memorization can be manipulated through targeted linear edits, which is relevant to broader questions around memorization, parameter locality, and post-pretraining control. This is better read as an analytically useful method paper than as a change to large-scale pretraining practice itself.","technical_approach":"$53","experiments":"$54","reading_guide":"For a skim, start with the motivation around quantization-induced recovery of forgotten content. draft sandbox 中做外部调研，查官方文档、GitHub issue、Stack Overflow 等，寻找具体且可复现的工程问题，例如版本冲突、配置陷阱、依赖 bug、边界条件。第二步，它联合生成任务说明、执行环境和验证测试，并做结构校验与 energy lift：在真实前向输入 x 上，用 mount 诱导的写入方向去解释整个站点的写入张量 Δh，而不是只解释 tile 内局部输出。B 类看 coverage 和 saturation：包括权重 Frobenius 能量覆盖、稀疏写入覆盖、相对随机字典的 coverage lift，以及随着每 tile mode 数增加是否很快饱和。C 类只用于 residual write 站点，检查这些 write 方向是否能通过 post-norm 残差注入，在最终 unembedding 几何上产生可检测的 logit 变化；指标是 Spearman ρ 和 top-20 Jaccard。\n\n另一个重要细节是 effective-path mounts。作者发现对 mlp.up 和 attn.v，直接拿原始模块权重做 residual-shaped decision-time working memory 明确分开。系统由五个模块组成：Recorder、Router、Composer、Render、Adapter。推理时主要用前四个模块。Recorder 把真实交互记录成统一 event stream，既保留原始事件，也保留结构化字段，如动作前观察、执行动作、环境反馈、奖励或步骤标签、任务元信息等。这里的设计意图是让持久层尽量保持中性和可复用，不提前把历史压缩成某一种固定摘要。\n\nRouter 是一个轻量的 view policy，它不直接输出环境动作，而是先选择“该怎么看历史”。作者把 view action 定义成几个维度的组合：relation type、evidence
